AWS Bedrock returns 403 Forbidden (not 401) when credentials are missing, expired, or the IAM role lacks bedrock:InvokeModel permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0\"}")
    _ = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
} catch {
    let _errorMessage = String(describing: error)
    let _errorType = String(describing: type(of: error))
    XCTAssertTrue(_errorMessage.contains("Authentication") || _errorType.contains("Authentication"), "expected error to mention \"Authentication\", got message: \(_errorMessage), type: \(_errorType)")
}
```
